name: notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1
description: ⭐ THE HOST DRAW, SHAPED BY SEAT COUNT: S17 PAYS AT TWO AND THREE SEATS AND NOT AT FOUR (rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4 = 0; the 2 and 3 slots stay null and therefore defer to the scalar rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisit, which this arm inherits at 1). ⛔ ITS CONTROL AND ITS PAIRED ARM IS overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-v1.overlay.json, AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY ONE LEAF. Two and three seats must come back BYTE-IDENTICAL to that arm - that is the correctness gate, not a hope - and the whole of the difference must appear at four seats. ⛔ ANY MOVEMENT IN THE 2p OR 3p COLUMNS IS A LEAK AND NOT A FINDING. ⛔ WHY IT EXISTS, AND IT IS THE LAST LEVER STANDING BECAUSE THE OTHERS ARE MEASURED AND DEAD. S17 was ruled in from a two-player table on 11/09/2026 and it takes the bonus slot out of Dean's 30%-60% band AT FOUR SEATS ALONE: 64.9% of turns against a 60% ceiling, where the one-leaf control reads 59.9% and two and three seats barely move (43.1% against 44.0%, 49.0% against 49.2%). THE CAP WAS BUILT AND RUN THE SAME DAY AND IT FAILED: overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-capped-v1.overlay.json paid a host at most once between their own turns, which removed 28.7% of the payments at four seats (98.7% of visits paid falling to 70.0%; the per-turn faucet 0.787 to 0.550) and returned only 0.5 POINTS OF RATE, landing at 64.4% and still out of band (reports/watchlist-2026-09-11T21-26-55-reference-v15-notice-board-visit-host-draw-capped-v1.txt). ⭐ THE FINDING THAT FORCED THIS SHAPE IS WORTH MORE THAN THE ARM: THE BONUS RATE IS NEARLY INSENSITIVE TO THE SIZE OF THE FAUCET. Cutting 30% of it bought back a TENTH of the rise. Extrapolated linearly, removing the faucet entirely recovers about 1.7 of the 5.0 points, so NO VERSION OF "MAKE THE HOST DRAW SMALLER" REACHES 60% AT FOUR SEATS. Pricing this faucet is a dead lever; only its PRESENCE is left to change, and this arm changes it exactly where there is no headroom. ⛔ WHAT TO READ, IN ORDER. (1) THE FOUR-SEAT RATE ON THE TURN MEASURE against the 60% ceiling - it should fall from 64.9% to at or near the control's own no-faucet reading of 59.9%, and ⚠️ 59.9% IS ITSELF ONLY ONE TENTH OF A POINT INSIDE THE CEILING, so a PASS here is a hair's breadth and not a margin. (2) THE 2p AND 3p COLUMNS, which must not move at all. (3) a08 THE HOOK at four seats, because this arm removes the host's instant payment there and the hook is the design's own thesis: if visiting falls at four seats, the rule has bought the band at the cost of the thing the band is protecting. (4) a06 THE BARN GLUT, noting that the capped arm read +0.5 where the uncapped read +0.8 ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES - three arms now share identical per-seat glut behaviour and disagree only in the pooled median, which is an argument about the METRIC and not about the design. ⚠️ AND THE COST IS A SEAT-COUNT-DEPENDENT RULE AT THE TABLE, against this project's five-minute teach target. It is not unprecedented - rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats already shapes the board count 2/1/1 and this arm pins it - but TWO seat-count-dependent rules in one bonus slot is a thing for Dean to look at WHOLE before ruling in, not a thing to notice afterwards. ⛔ A four-player game would be taught "you draw when a neighbour visits you, except you do not", and no run can price that. ⚠️ THE HONEST ALTERNATIVE READING, RECORDED SO NOBODY HAS TO REDERIVE IT: THE CONTROL HAS NO HEADROOM AT FOUR SEATS EITHER (59.9%), so the finding may be that NO CARD FAUCET FITS AT FOUR SEATS rather than that this one is mis-sized - in which case the question is whether a 60% ceiling applied identically at every seat count is the right test, which is a ruling about the BAND and not about S17. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME, because the 05/09/2026 lesson is that ruling an arm in rules in its whole bundle. TWENTY LEAVES: the nineteen of the host-draw arm, unchanged, plus this one. THE NEW LEAF: rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4 = 0, and the ONLY difference from the control. The 2 and 3 slots are deliberately NOT pinned: they ship null, null means defer to the scalar, and pinning them would make this a three-leaf arm and break the one-leaf pairing that makes the 2p and 3p identity gate readable. The other nineteen are listed in full in the control's own description and are not restated here so the two files cannot drift. ⚠️ THE PARENT ARM'S MEASUREMENT CAVEAT CARRIES UNCHANGED: THE SIMULATOR CANNOT MEASURE THE EFFECT DEAN LIKED. The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none, so the instrument clips exactly the extra cards in hand that relieved the tightness. No report of any arm in this family may be quoted as evidence about tightness in either direction. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the host-draw arm on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run.
